cases.prompt: Add delete support for gallery images. Users should be able to remove any of their saved images from the My Images gallery.
cases.expectation: The plan must cover all layers of the vertical slice: (1) Add `DeleteAsync(string userId, string imageId, CancellationToken ct = default)` to `src/PoRedoImage.Domain/Interfaces/IUserImageRepository.cs`. (2) Implement it in `src/PoRedoImage.Infrastructure/Repositories/AzureBlobUserImageRepository.cs` — delete the blob via `BlobClient.DeleteIfExistsAsync` and the table row via `TableClient.DeleteEntityAsync`, following the existing `EnsureInitializedAsync` pattern. (3) Add `DeleteImageAsync(string userId, string imageId, CancellationToken ct = default)` to `src/PoRedoImage.Application/Services/IUserImageService.cs` and implement it in `src/PoRedoImage.Application/Services/UserImageService.cs`. (4) Add a `DELETE /api/user-images/{id}` endpoint in `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Features/UserImages/UserImageEndpoints.cs` — return 204 on success, 404 if not found, re-use the existing hex-id sanitization guard. (5) Add a delete button to `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Components/Shared/MyImagesGallery.razor` that calls the new endpoint and refreshes the gallery. (6) Add unit tests in `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Unit/Features/` verifying null/missing-config guard clauses for the new service method. (7) Add integration tests in `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration/` (alongside `BulkGenerateEndpointTests.cs`) verifying HTTP 204 for a valid delete and HTTP 404 for a non-existent image, using `MockedServicesWebApplicationFactory`. Verify with `dotnet test tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Unit` and `dotnet test tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration --filter "Category!=Docker"`.

cases.prompt: The gallery currently loads all images in one shot. Add cursor-based pagination to the user image list so we don't fetch everything at once.
cases.expectation: The plan must address: (1) Add `Task<(IReadOnlyList<UserImage> Items, string? ContinuationToken)> GetByUserPagedAsync(string userId, int pageSize, string? continuationToken, CancellationToken ct = default)` to `src/PoRedoImage.Domain/Interfaces/IUserImageRepository.cs`. (2) Implement in `src/PoRedoImage.Infrastructure/Repositories/AzureBlobUserImageRepository.cs` using `TableClient.QueryAsync` with `maxPerPage` and `Azure.Page<T>` continuation tokens. (3) Add a `PagedGalleryResponse` record (with `Items` and `ContinuationToken?` properties) to `src/PoRedoImage.Shared/DTOs/UserImageDtos.cs`. (4) Add `GetGalleryPagedAsync` to `src/PoRedoImage.Application/Services/IUserImageService.cs` and implement in `UserImageService.cs` mapping `UserImage` to `UserImageDto` inline. (5) Add a `GET /api/user-images?pageSize=20&continuationToken=...` overload in `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Features/UserImages/UserImageEndpoints.cs` — accept `pageSize` (default 20, max 100) and optional `continuationToken` query params; return `PagedGalleryResponse`. (6) Update `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Components/Shared/MyImagesGallery.razor` to track `_continuationToken` state and render a 'Load more' button that calls the new paged endpoint. (7) Add integration tests in `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration/` verifying the paged endpoint returns 200 with the expected JSON shape. Verify with `dotnet build PoRedoImage.slnx` and `dotnet test tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration --filter "Category!=Docker"`.

cases.prompt: Add a 'Tags' field to UserImage so the vision analysis tags are persisted with each saved image and returned in the gallery.
cases.expectation: The plan must touch every layer: (1) Add `Tags` (`IReadOnlyList<string>`, defaulting to an empty list) to `src/PoRedoImage.Domain/Entities/UserImage.cs` and update the static `UserImage.Create(...)` factory signature to accept an optional `IEnumerable<string>? tags = null` parameter. (2) Add a `Tags` column (stored as a JSON-serialized string) to `UserImageTableEntity` in `src/PoRedoImage.Infrastructure/Repositories/AzureBlobUserImageRepository.cs`; update `MapToDomain` to deserialize it and `SaveMetadataAsync` to serialize it with `System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer`. (3) Update `SaveOriginalAsync` and `SaveResultAsync` in `src/PoRedoImage.Application/Services/IUserImageService.cs` and `UserImageService.cs` to accept an optional `IReadOnlyList<string>? tags` parameter and forward it to `UserImage.Create`. (4) Update `src/PoRedoImage.Shared/DTOs/UserImageDtos.cs` — add `Tags` (`IReadOnlyList<string>`) to `UserImageDto` record; update `UserImageService.GetGalleryAsync` mapping to include tags. (5) In `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Components/Pages/ImageRegeneration.razor`, forward `analysisResult.Tags` when calling `AutoSaveResultAsync`. (6) Add a `[Theory]` + `[InlineData]` unit test in `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Unit/Features/` verifying tags round-trip correctly through `UserImage.Create`. Verify with `dotnet test tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Unit`.

cases.prompt: The bulk generation loop runs sequentially and blocks the UI. Replace it with true parallel generation using a configurable concurrency limit.
cases.expectation: The plan must cover: (1) Add a `BulkGenerate:MaxConcurrency` config key (integer, default 3) documented in `src/PoRedoImage.Web/appsettings.json`. (2) Replace the `for` loop in the `StartGeneration` method of `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Components/Pages/BulkGenerate.razor` with a `SemaphoreSlim`-gated parallel dispatch — create one `Task` per slot, each acquiring the semaphore before calling the `/api/bulk-generate/variation` endpoint, releasing it in `finally`. (3) Update `_results[i].Status` assignments to use `InvokeAsync(() => { ... StateHasChanged(); })` to safely marshal back to the Blazor render thread. (4) Ensure `_cts.Token.IsCancellationRequested` is checked after each semaphore acquire so cancellation drains cleanly. (5) Document that the `ai-endpoints` rate-limiting policy in `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Program.cs` (10 req/min sliding window) is the governing throttle; the concurrency limit adds a secondary cap on in-flight requests to avoid queue buildup. (6) Update the integration test `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration/BulkGenerateEndpointTests.cs` to add a test confirming concurrent POST /api/bulk-generate/variation calls all return 200. Verify with `dotnet build PoRedoImage.slnx --configuration Release`.

cases.prompt: Expose per-request AI cost estimates (USD) in the API response and surface them in the processing metrics panel in the UI.
cases.expectation: The plan must span all layers: (1) Add `EstimatedCostUsd` (`double`) to `ProcessingMetricsDto` in `src/PoRedoImage.Shared/DTOs/ImageAnalysisResponse.cs`; it must remain a regular settable property (not computed) since it aggregates across heterogeneous services. (2) Add an optional `double EstimatedCostUsd` out-field to the return tuples of `EnhanceDescriptionAsync` and `GenerateImageAsync` in `src/PoRedoImage.Domain/Interfaces/IGenerativeAiService.cs`; add the same to `IImagen3Service.GenerateAsync` in `src/PoRedoImage.Domain/Interfaces/IImagen3Service.cs`. (3) Compute costs in `src/PoRedoImage.Infrastructure/Services/AzureOpenAiService.cs` using published GPT-4.1-nano and DALL-E 3 per-token/per-image rates (configurable via `OpenAI:CostPerToken` and `OpenAI:CostPerImage` config keys with hardcoded defaults); do the same in `src/PoRedoImage.Infrastructure/Services/GeminiImagen3Service.cs` using `Google:CostPerImage`. (4) Accumulate costs in `src/PoRedoImage.Application/Services/ImageAnalysisOrchestrator.cs` inside `ProcessAsync` and set `metrics.EstimatedCostUsd`. (5) Update the mock in `tests/PoRedoImage.Tests.Integration/ImageAnalysisEndpointTests.cs` (`MockedServicesWebApplicationFactory.CreateMockOpenAI`) to return a non-zero cost value, and add an assertion that `metrics.estimatedCostUsd` is present and >= 0 in `AnalyzeImage_ReturnsMetrics`. (6) Surface the value in the Blazor results panel `src/PoRedoImage.Web/Components/Pages/ImageRegenerationResultsPanel.razor` as a formatted string (e.g., `$0.0042`). Verify with `dotnet test PoRedoImage.slnx --configuration Release`.
